M08 MOVEMENT LAB · A/B/C TEST

Breakwater Run

Three movement styles on the same short course. Athletic has our new custom animations, a controlled leap, gentler camera, and ground lunge. Precision is a near-instant controller. Legacy preserves M07. This is a motion lab—not a combat level.

Desktop: ←→ move · Space jump · Shift lunge/rush. Tablet: stick + JUMP + action button. Tap the movement-style button to compare all three modes.
